events.label: birth
events.text: Georges Pompidou born in Montboudif, Cantal, France.

evidence.quote: Georges Jean Raymond Pompidou was born on 5 July 1911 in the commune of Montboudif

events.label: award
events.text: Made Chevalier of the Legion of Honour.

evidence.quote: Chevalier de la Legion of Honour : ( France ) ( 1948 )

events.text: Hired by Guy de Rothschild to work at Rothschild bank.

evidence.quote: until hired in 1953 by Guy de Rothschild to work at Rothschild

events.text: Appointed general manager of the Rothschild bank.

evidence.quote: In 1956 , he was appointed the banks general manager

events.label: award
events.text: Made Officier of the Legion of Honour.

evidence.quote: Officier de la Legion of Honour : ( France ) ( 1957 )

events.text: Published the anthology Anthologie de la Poesie Francaise.

evidence.quote: Anthologie de la Poésie Française , Livre de Poche/Hachette , 1961

events.text: Ended tenure as general manager of the Rothschild bank.

evidence.quote: In 1956 , he was appointed the banks general manager , a position he held until 1962

events.label: award
events.text: Made Grand Cross of the Order of St Olav (Norway).

evidence.quote: Grand Cross of Order of St . Olav ( Norway ) ( 1962 )

events.text: Began tenure as Prime Minister of France under de Gaulle.

evidence.quote: He served as prime minister of France under de Gaulle after Michel Debré resigned , from 14 April 1962 to 10 July 1968

events.text: Defeated in a no-confidence vote; de Gaulle dissolved the Assembly.

evidence.quote: In October 1962 , he was defeated in a vote of no-confidence

events.text: Second government formed with Pompidou as Prime Minister.

evidence.quote: Second ministry , 28 November 1962 – 8 January 1966

events.label: policy
events.text: Government under Pompidou established the National Employment Fund.

evidence.quote: witnessed the establishment of the National Employment Fund in 1963

events.label: crisis
events.text: Faced a miners' strike as Prime Minister.

evidence.quote: In 1964 , he was faced with a miners strike

events.text: Third government formed with Pompidou as Prime Minister.

evidence.quote: Third ministry , 8 January 1966 – 6 April 1967

events.label: legislative election
events.text: Led UDR legislative campaign to a narrow victory.

evidence.quote: He led the 1967 legislative campaign of the Union of Democrats for the Fifth Republic to a narrow victory

events.label: legislative election
events.text: Led and won the 1968 legislative campaign for the Gaullist Party.

evidence.quote: Pompidou led and won the 1968 legislative campaign

events.label: crisis resolution
events.text: Credited with peaceful resolution of May 1968 student uprising via Grenelle talks.

evidence.quote: Pompidou was widely regarded as being responsible for the peaceful resolution of the student uprising of May 1968

events.text: Fifth government formed with Pompidou as Prime Minister.

evidence.quote: Fifth ministry , 30 May – 10 July 1968

events.text: Ended tenure as Prime Minister after resigning.

evidence.quote: He served as prime minister of France under de Gaulle after Michel Debré resigned , from 14 April 1962 to 10 July 1968

events.label: award
events.text: Made Grand Cross of the Legion of Honour.

evidence.quote: Grand-croix de la Legion of Honour : 1969

events.text: Became grand master of the Legion of Honour as president.

evidence.quote: grand-maître de lordre ( France ) ( 1969-1974 , as president of the republic )

events.text: Announced his candidacy for the Presidency of France.

evidence.quote: his candidature for the Presidency in January 1969

events.text: Won presidential election, defeating Alain Poher; became President of France.

evidence.quote: In the general election of 15 June 1969 , he defeated the centrist President of the Senate

events.label: state visit
events.text: Visited Mauritania, Senegal, Ivory Coast, Cameroon and Gabon.

evidence.quote: In 1971 , he visited Mauritania , Senegal , Ivory Coast , Cameroon , and Gabon

events.text: Replaced Prime Minister Chaban-Delmas with Pierre Messmer.

evidence.quote: In 1972 , he replaced Chaban-Delmas with Pierre Messmer

events.label: award
events.text: Made Honorary Knight Grand Cross of the Order of the Bath.

evidence.quote: Honorary Knight Grand Cross of the Order of the Bath ( United Kingdom ) ( 1972 )

events.label: award
events.text: Made Knight Grand Cross with Collar of the Order of Merit of the Italian Republic.

evidence.quote: Knight Grand Cross with Collar of Order of Merit of the Italian Republic ( 1973 )

events.text: Ended tenure as grand master of the Legion of Honour.

evidence.quote: grand-maître de lordre ( France ) ( 1969-1974 , as president of the republic )

events.text: Published the book Le Nœud gordien.

evidence.quote: Le Nœud gordien , éd . Plon , 1974

events.label: death
events.text: Died in his apartment while in office as president.

evidence.quote: While still in office , Pompidou died on 2 April 1974

events.label: burial
events.text: Body buried in the churchyard of Orvilliers.

evidence.quote: His body was buried on 4 April , in the churchyard of Orvilliers
